components.label: ICBC MV6020 Guide

components.html:
Electronic MV6020 Traffic Accident Report

 

This form will change in response to the data entered; please complete it in order from the beginning.

Add Entities (vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians) and Involved Persons as needed using the buttons. If a person was in a vehicle but was outside the vehicle at the time of collision, enter them as a Pedestrian entity.

Fields that are automatically calculated (as indicated in the caption and shaded in grey) cannot be manually changed, and some drop-down fields will only show valid values based on your responses (for example, the Entity type (vehicle, pedestrian, or cyclist), and the status of the Involved Persons (not injured, injured, or deceased) determine the available options for related fields).

If information is unknown or not applicable, you must select 00 Unknown or 98 Not Applicable - do not leave blank unless you have checked "Unknown Entity". If either the Date of Collision or a Date of Death is unknown, enter your best estimate in the field and note this in the Police Comments. All input will be validated prior to submission to ICBC.

To navigate with the keyboard: use Tab to go to the next field, Shift plus Tab to go to the previous field, the Arrow keys to navigate between radio buttons (Space bar to select), the Arrow keys to scroll through drop down boxes (or enter first character to jump to entries starting with that character), and Enter to select/deselect checkboxes and click buttons.

      <bpmn:script>import org.camunda.spin.Spin
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput

// Get JSON string from execution variable
var formData = S(execution.getVariable("formData"));

// Remove the `currentUserRole` field
formData.deleteProp("currentUserRole");

formData.prop("ff_application_id", applicationId);

// Read environment variable
def system = java.lang.System
def icbcEmail = system.getenv('ICBC_OPS_EMAIL')

// Build print_options dynamically using Spin
def printOptions = Spin.JSON('''{
  "type": "icbc",
  "email": "",
  "is_draft": false
}''')

// Inject dynamic email value
printOptions.prop("email", icbcEmail)

formData.prop("print_options", printOptions)


// Build the nested payload as a Spin JSON object
def payload = Spin.JSON('''{
    "template": "mv6020.html",
    "data": {},
    "options": {
        "type": "email",
        "filename": ""
    }
}''')

// Set the dynamic values
payload.prop("data", formData)

// Extract collision case number as plain string
def collisionCaseNum = formData.prop("collision_case_num")?.stringValue()

// Fallback if null
if (!collisionCaseNum) {
    collisionCaseNum = "unknown"
}
payload.prop("options").prop("filename", "MV6020_${collisionCaseNum}.pdf")


// Change report: the parent revision, so the DF API can highlight what changed.
def parentSubmission = execution.getVariable("parentSubmission")
if (parentSubmission) {
    payload.prop("parentData", S(parentSubmission.toString()).prop("data"))
}

execution.setVariable("payload", payload.toString())</bpmn:script>

      <bpmn:script>import groovy.json.JsonSlurper

// Change report: build the Form.io URL of the parent revision. New reports leave it null.
def data = new JsonSlurper().parseText(S(execution.getVariable("formData")).toString())
def url = null
def ids = '^[0-9a-f]{24}$'  // Form.io ObjectIds only
if (String.valueOf(data.isChangeReport) == "true") {
    def formId = String.valueOf(data.parentFormId)
    def submissionId = String.valueOf(data.parentSubmissionId)
    if (formId ==~ ids) {
        if (submissionId ==~ ids) {
            def formUrl = String.valueOf(execution.getVariable("formUrl"))
            def base = formUrl.substring(0, formUrl.indexOf("/form/"))
            url = base + "/form/" + formId + "/submission/" + submissionId
        }
    }
}
execution.setVariable("parentSubmissionUrl", url)</bpmn:script>
